notes: Gaps for the owner (design, not code): (1) Payer-written line-type wording outranks names. A payer who writes 'REFUND' or 'FROM SAVINGS' in a reference moves a line out of director funding or a lender drawdown into refund_in or own_account_transfer, and a profile director name cannot take it back because line-type rules are protected. All of these are non-trading (NON_TRADING_IN), so M2, M9 and M16 do not move, but the M19-M22 bucket split can be misled. Only a per-line override corrects it. Decide whether profile names should rank above the own-pot/savings cue. (2) A credit with both HMRC and refund wording is hmrc_repayment by design; a refund from a merchant called HMRC-something would land there too. (3) CMA_RULESET still defaults to v1; switching the default to v2 is rollout step 2 and is not in this change. (4) ruff reports 14 errors only in previously committed .bridgie/runs/** helper scripts inside this branch (implementer-02, implementer-05); src, tests and evals are clean. Those run files should not be in the branch, and removing them is for the owner.
